notes.title: v1.0.1 quick patch
notes.notes: Fixes a crash I missed when entering side-branches because of a data file that was outdated. Sorry to anyone who experienced the crashes.

notes.title: Update 0.6.4 - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Since I've mostly been working on fixes for Version 1.0 I figured I might as well release them incrementally so everyone can enjoy them!

This is a minor update to fix a bunch of random bugs and small quality of life improvements.

[list]
[*] Fixed a few random crashes. Mostly issues with bad JSON data.
[*] Small UI tweaks (colors, visuals, dialog sizes and such)
[*] On PC you can now right-click units to automatically see an item's description instead of having to click on the look button!
[*] Fixed "Cooled" EMP not cooling
[*] Fixed Bren's Story (in the Crew section) that wasn't working as intended
[/list]

notes.title: 0-day patch for Update 6
notes.notes: If you're stuck and the game keep crashing after the update let me know and I'll make an updater to fix the savegame too. Sorry for the inconvenience!

notes.title: The Electronic Warfare Update
notes.notes:
Finally something that's been on my todo list for a really long time but that required a lot (and I mean a LOT) of changes, it's time for ships to do more than just shoot lasers at each others! 

Ships (both players and enemies!) will be able to equip tools and weapons that can hack into other ship's computer. You'll be able to choose which system to disable with the new Remote DataHack weapon and if you're in a pinch you'll be able to disable every enemy ship around you for a while with the a powerful EMP blast! Watch out for cooldown on that EMP tough!

[h1]New in Update 6[/h1]
[list]
[*]Electronic Warfare Stats, Weapons, Utility and Effects
[*]New Grab Dialog will not only allow picking up resources faster but also be more discerning about what you want to bring aboard
[*]Added a prompt to warn player when starting a new game will delete your previous save
[*]Added an option to disable the camera auto-follow player
[/list]

[h1]Major Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed a crash when changing recipe in the converter dialog
[*]Fixed containers regenerating their content when picked up
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.5.0 is Here!
notes.notes:
Major changes for the Alpha 5! I'm even considering making it the last release before 1.0 depending on how many things I need to iron out after such a massive release!

What's new in release 0.5.0
- Jerg branch complete with story and boss fight!
- Vorg branch complete with story and boss fight!
- New death and victory animations
- New sounds
- New HUD layout
- New items
- AI improvements
- Bug fixes

Be sure to check it out because now getting to the end is not enough! To get a really good high score, you'll need to venture into the Jerg and Vorg branches where powerful bosses await! To do this you'll have to figure out the best strategy to target the bosses weaknesses and build a custom ship capable of handling them!

notes.title: Solar Rogue Alpha 4 Patch
notes.notes:
Thanks to several player who reported the crash. I'm very sad it slipped through the cracks when I was testing Alpha 4. Hopefully there won't be anything else major until Alpha 5.

Minor fixes and improvements will come in Alpha 5 along with a complete UI overhaul and some new content as usual!

notes.title: Version 0.3.3 is Live!
notes.notes:
New features
• Mining Laser
• Speed Boost Utility
• Railguns!
• Emergency Warp
• Trading Ships!
• Human branch now end with the Human Coalition!
• Police AI. Attacks when you do something mean!
• Paletted colors for sun
• Added various sounds fx
• Victory Theme

Bug Fixes
• Fixed Minor Visual Glitches
• Fixed Scanner FX becoming choppy
• AI hunt you down if they get hurt from far away
• Major Balance Changes to Jerg, Weapons, Speed and Energy Costs
• Fixed crash when dying while crafting
• Fixed crash for some random item spawn
• Fixed issue where ship would move when inside menus
• Performance improvements

Stay tuned for Version 0.4. Lot's of things planned for the next update
